hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a parameterized kernel K(θ):=V(θ)*G0(θ)*V(θ). Each target member is obtained from this single template by substituting θ=p or θ=q.
required_assumptions: p and q are valid arguments for the unary functions V and G0.
hypotheses.rationale: The two terms have the same operator-product structure V(·)G0(·)V(·), differing only by the parameter label p or q. This makes them instances of one parameterized kernel rather than unrelated expressions.
